use_case_summary: Primary: IDE copilot/autocomplete that reproduces suggestions deterministically for tested model versions
Secondary: background code completions for CI linting and batch code-mod suggestions
Key metrics: keystroke-to-suggestion latency <100ms median, 99th <500ms; suggestion stability across pinned builds
Must support streaming partial tokens to the editor (delta updates) and resume-on-connect behavior
technical_requirements: Model/version pinning: ability to bind project/repo to exact model artifact sha (not logical alias)
Rollouts: per-repo canary percentages, time-based canaries, automatic rollback on eval-gate failures
Eval gates: run regression suite (compile + unit tests + lint) against both baseline and candidate; metric thresholds for promotion
Reproducibility: deterministic tokenization, fixed seed for sampling (when used), KV-cache persistence across pinned runs
Latency: streaming token SLOs, configurable batching window with developer-focused defaults
Observability: token-level cost, per-suggestion latency, per-model regressions and diffed outputs stored for audits
Security: VPC private endpoints, enterprise KMS for model keys, audit logs retained 1y+, SSO for admin console
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (POC) - Host pinned model v2.1 on a small dedicated pool; integrate with VSCode extension dev channel
Phase 2 - Canary: route 1% of org traffic from selected repos for 48h; collect regression signals (compile/test/lint), user satisfaction telemetry
Phase 3 - Expand to 10% if no regressions for 72h; run nightly automated eval-gates that compare candidate vs pinned baseline
Phase 4 - Full rollout with opt-in beta toggles and automatic fallback to baseline model on failures
Key success criteria: no >0.5% increase in failing unit tests attributable to suggestion diffs; 99th latency within SLO
evaluation_results: POC week 1: integrated Redwood SDK into internal VSCode - basic suggestions working
Latency: local office median 45ms per suggestion; remote tests show median 120ms, 99th 380ms (needs improvement)
Determinism check: for greedy completions with pinned model v2.0 we see 98.6% identical suggestions across runs; sampling-mode variability expected
Regression suite (50k quick tests): candidate v2.1 produced 0.3% additional lint failures vs baseline; flagged by automated eval-gate
Customer-provided user study (20 devs): 14/20 preferred v2.1 suggestions for readability, but 3 reported flaky reproductions on edge cases
